bio.text: Matt Little is the Democratic-Farmer-Labor candidate for Minnesota's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, after winning the August primary.
He is a former two-term mayor of Lakeville and represented the area in the Minnesota Senate from 2016 to 2020, when he lost re-election to a Republican.
He is a personal injury attorney and lives in New Market Township, according to the Minnesota Reformer.

sources.title: Former state Sen. Matt Little announces U.S. House campaign to replace Craig
Matt Little wins DFL primary in CD2, will face Eric Pratt in general election
